highlights.headline: Commission approves €23 billion Italian State aid scheme to support renewable electricity production*
highlights.summary: European Commission Press release Brussels, 08 Jun 2026 The European Commission has approved a €23 billion Italian State aid scheme to support electricity production from renewable energy sources, in line with the objectives of the Clean Industrial Deal. This measure will contribute to the transition towards a net-zero economy and reaching the renewable energy target set at EU level for 2030.
